name: switch
summary: Turns a setting on or off as soon as it changes: a track and its thumb, named by its label, with read-only, disabled, required and invalid.

notCovered.name: the touch target
notCovered.why: Under a coarse pointer UI SDK lays an empty box over each switch, so a tap near it reaches it: over the whole label, at least 2.75rem tall, when a label holds the switch, and 2.75rem each way around the switch itself when none does, as in a field. Either box draws nothing, so no light reads its size, and the part leaves both as UI SDK sets them.
